hero.title: 'SERIOUS' + YOUR BRAND
hero.subtitle: An intimate gaming and IRL community that watches 2-4 hours every single day. Not just passive subscribers, but people who are actually in the room.

pitch: 451 subscribers. 5.9% CTR, above platform average. 5-6 streams a week, loyal fan base, always growing and involving new viewers.

differentiator.title: THE TRUST ADVANTAGE
differentiator.body: 8 years streaming, 13 years creating content. Putting my all into it, and results show up fast. A community that shows up for 15 hours of live content per week builds a parasocial bond that passive subscribers never develop. When I integrate your brand, it lands like a recommendation from a friend, not an ad they skip.

pillars.label: NO SCRIPT READS
pillars.body: Every integration is spoken by me, in my voice, around what the product actually does. Your brand becomes content, not interruption. Written in parallel with you and my branding.

pillars.label: TECHNICAL DEPTH
pillars.body: Background in Software and Electrical Engineering, ex-professional VALORANT player, and a strong connection with athleticism. No matter what the topic is, I have my unique spin and integration into my content beyond just reactions.

pillars.label: MULTI-PLATFORM
pillars.body: Every stream runs simultaneously on YouTube, Twitch, and TikTok. Your placement reaches the same engaged audience across all platforms in a single session.

pillars.label: EARLY ADVANTAGE
pillars.body: +165 Subscribers, +267,000 Impressions, +18,000 views, +7-10 average viewer streams. All in less than 2 months of consistent grinding. The continued growth and expansion is only destined.

packages.name: STREAM MENTION
packages.deliverable: Verbal mention + on-screen brand placement during a 2–3 hour livestream on YouTube and Twitch. Link drops in chat and bio for 7 days.

packages.name: INTEGRATED SEGMENT
packages.deliverable: 60–90 second integrated segment inside an edited gameplay or vlog video. Custom written, brand-aligned, no script-read energy. Permanent on-channel.
packages.ideal: Products with a story to tell

packages.name: REVIEW + WRITEUP
packages.deliverable: A full feature review (ie. tech piece, new game, product) in its own >=90 minute stream, featuring an edited video and a blog post in full reviewed detail. The best case for a product or company to get the maximum viewership possible.

packages.name: CUSTOM
packages.deliverable: Multi-stream campaigns, brand sponsorships, affiliate programs, product gifting. Built around your goals and my utmost support.
